description: How far do you want to progress during this playthrough?
The selected Tower Boss defines the maximum intended progression. However, you may not need to reach that boss to complete your chosen Victory Condition(s).
Technologies unlocked beyond the selected Tower Boss will be removed from the item pool.

For reference, each Tower Boss roughly corresponds to the following highest resource tier: Cloth (Zoe) → Leather (Lily) → Ingot (Axel) → Refined Ingot (Marcus) → Pal Metal (Victor) → Plasteel (Saya) → Hexolite (Bjorn) → Coralum & Soralite (Auri) → Paloxite (World Tree).
For reference, the level of each Tower Boss goes from 10 (Zoe) → 20 (Lily) → 30 (Axel) → 40 (Marcus) → 50 (Victor) → 55 (Saya) → 60 (Bjorn) → 70 (Auri) → 80 (World Tree)
Regions accessible will be determined by the lowest Pal Level accessible in comparison to the Tower Boss selected as max progression.
Exceptions may occur such as Isle of Murmurs and Isle of Silence being disabled if Zoe is the Max Progression as those islands are shut off by higher level areas.
Pals that you can find as Alpha Bosses, in the Wild or in Dungeons are restricted by how far you wish the progression shall go.
Pals are automatically logically removed even if they would be able to be found earlier by other means such as fishing, eggs and from merchants!
Includes all Palpedia Entries as Checks.
This option is also required for logic involving specific Pals.
If this option is disabled, it is intended for players who wish to use Palworld's in-game randomizer and do not want checks that require specific Pals.
If this option is disabled you'll still require the Pal Gear Workbench to reach long distances, but it won't be able to guarantee that you have access to a rideable mount.
If this option is disabled you may have to use the Global Palbox to get Pals required for certains options as all pals will technically be in logic without this option!
Includes all of the Raid Pals as Palpedia locations.
Does nothing if 'Enable_Palpedia' is disabled.
Includes all of the Alpha Pals you encounter as overworld bosses as locations.
This option is automatically disabled if 'Player_Access' only goes to Zoe.
If this is disabled, they'll still be accounted for in the logic of capturing various pals.
Includes all of the various NPCs which glow purple you encounter as overworld bosses as locations.
Includes all of the Main Missions as checks.
Include all Sub Missions as checks.
Includes all Journals as checks.
Includes all of the Base Building Tasks as checks.
Includes all Research in the Pal Research Lab as checks.
If 'Enable_Palpedia' is disabled it will not check if you have any pals with appropiate Work Suitabilities for each tier of research.
Includes all of the Ancient Ruins scattered around the world as checks.
Ancient Ruins are locations that reward loot after solving their puzzles.
Some Ancient Ruins require combat and as such the ruins won't be in logic until you are the same level as the region you find them in.
You may still activate the ruins beforehand if you wish but they won't be in logic until then.
Includes all of the Rainbow Passives as locations.
Requires a lot of luck early to obtain most of them.
Will include the World Tree Passives as well if 'player_access' is at the highest.
Mutation passives are also included if you have access to Breeding.
Every Lifmunk Effigy found in the world is a check.
Lifmunk Effigies increases Capture Power.
Every Lamball Effigy found at the Bamboo Groves, Crescent Moon Shore and Verdant Brook is a check.
Lamball Effigies increases Satiety Duration.
Every Pengullet Effigy found in Volcanic Areas is a check.
Pengullet Effigies increases Swimming Ability.
Requires Mount Obsidian to be accessible due to 'player_access'.
Every Munchill Effigy found in Desert Areas is a check.
Munchill Effigies increases Food Preservation.
Requires The Desiccated Dunes to be accessible due to 'player_access'.
Every Rooby Effigy found in the Astral Mountains is a check.
Rooby Effigies increases Jump Power.
Requires The Astral Mountains to be accessible due to 'player_access'.
Every Herbil Effigy found in Sakurajima is a check.
Herbil Effigies increases Flight Capacity.
Requires Sakurajima to be accessible due to 'player_access'.
Every Tanzee Effigy found in Feybreak is a check.
Tanzee Effigies increases Climbing Profiency.
Requires Feybreak to be accessible due to 'player_access'.
Every Depresso Effigy found in Sunreach is a check.
Depresso Effigies increases Status Resistance.
Requires Sunreach to be accessible due to 'player_access'.
Every Cattiva Effigy found in the World Tree is a check.
Cattiva Effigies increases Endurance.
Requires The World Tree to be accessible due to 'player_access'.
Every Lunaris Effigy found in the world is a check.
Lunaris Effigies grants Sphere Tracking.
Requires Crescent Moon Shore to be accessible due to 'player_access'.
Every Relaxaurus Effigy found in the world is a check.
Relaxaurus Effigies increases EXP Gain.
Requires Mount Obsidian to be accessible due to 'player_access'.
Every Yakumo Effigy found in the world is a check.
Yakumo Effigies increases the odds of finding Rainbow Passive Skills on Wild Pals.
Requires Feybreak to be accessible due to 'player_access'.
You receive a Mimog Effigy from capturing every pal 5 times, as such those checks will be enabled with this option.
Mimog Effigies increases Movement Speed.
When enabled, will also randomize Ancient Technology unlocks.
Adds one of each Vanity Schematic into the item pool.
Vanity schematics are mostly the hats and caps that provide no real armor but can be used to customize your character
Rank 1-2 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as filler items.
Rank 3-4 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as useful items.
Adds one of each Furniture Schematic into the item pool.
Furniture Schematics includes all the various building options you can obtain from hunting down the Enemy Bases
Rank 1-2 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as filler items.
Rank 3-4 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as useful items.
Adds one of each Weapon Schematic into the item pool.
This includes all the various weapon schematics you can find from Chests, Dungeons and dropped by Pals. This also includes the weapon schematics that can be bought from shops.
For the ULTRAKILL Collab Schematics to be added, you require both the Weapon and Armour Schematics to be enabled for it to exist.
Fishing Rod Schematics are included as Weapon Schematics
Rank 1-2 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as filler items.
Rank 3-4 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as useful items.
Adds one of each Armour Schematic into the item pool.
This includes all the various armour schematics you can find from Chests, Dungeons and dropped from Pals. This also includes the armour schematics that can be bought from shops.
For the ULTRAKILL Collab Schematics to be added, you require both the Weapon and Armour Schematics to be enabled for it to exist.
Rank 1-2 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as filler items.
Rank 3-4 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as useful items.
Adds 4 of each Raid Slab Fragment into the item pool.
The Slabs themselves will appear in your inventory upon receiveing four of each fragment.
These are considered progression items and will be required before Raid Bosses are in logic if you have them enabled.
This also adds the Celestial Sigil, the raid summoning item for the Moon Lord, but it is treated as a useful item.
Adds one of each Accessory Schematic into the item pool.
These are all considered as useful items.
Adds one of each skill fruit into the item pool.
Uncommon Skill Fruits are considered as filler items.
Rare and Epic Skill Fruits are considered as useful items.
Adds one of each Remedy and Elixir into the item pool. Potions that increase player stats.
Remedies and Elixirs are treated as Filler items.
Adds one of each manual into the pool. The ones giving Tech Points, Ancient Tech Points and Experience.
Manuals are considered fillers.
Adds one of each Key into the pool; Copper, Silver and Gold Key.
Chest Keys are considered fillers.
Adds one of each Pal Fruit into the item pool.
Fruits which increases a Pal's hidden stat values.
Starfruits which increases the potential of Pals.
Kinship fruits which increases the trust of Pals
Pal Fruits are treated as Useful items.
Adds one of each Pal Soul into the item pool.
Pal Souls are treated as Useful items.
Adds one of each of the Work Suitability Handbooks into the item pool.
Useful for players who can generate items into their own game.
Handbooks are treated as progression items and may be required for Research Tasks if they're enabled.
Adds one of each Implant and Disposable Implant into the item pool.
When obtained through the multiworld, you may use that Implant with the Pal Surgery Table or purchase it from the Bounty or Arena Merchant.
These will automatically be disabled if the Pal Surgery Table is inaccessible due to the 'Player_Access' option.
Implants are treated as Useful items.
Adds one of each Passive Skill into the item pool as items.
When obtained through the multiworld, allow yourself to use the Passives on Pals you capture or Breed.
World Tree and Rainbow Passives are treated as useful items.
Golden, White and Red Passives are treated as filler items.
If enabled, will lock level progression behind defeating Tower Bosses instead of with Region Access.
The Level Cap for Progression goes from 10>20>30>40>50>55>60>70>80.
If disabled, will lock level progression behind regions instead of the access to Tower Bosses.
For reference it will require for you to have access to Crescent Moon Shore>Mount Obsidian>Desiccated Dunes>Astral Mountains>Sakurajima>Feybreak>Sunreach>The World Tree
Either level cap require you to be able to craft and wear appropriate Body Armor as explained in the 'Player_Access' option for level progression.
NOTE: If using the tower level cap I made it so each boss gives an extra location with a placed item which is required to progress the level ups.
I did it so you wouldn't get too overwhelmed by the next level up tier until you feel ready for it! They're all the 'obtained key spheres locations'.
If enabled, will disable any logic requiring a specific level before it is in logic.
Essentially treating as you're able to reach level 80 from the beginning.
Could be fun to have a wildly randomized playthrough
Reccommended to not use the player progression locations unless you really want to level up to 80 immediately.
If Enabled, will add a location in the manual for you to click to receive your Palbox at start.
If Enabled, will give you a random 'Island Spawn' item which determines the island you start on.
If Disabled, it will always give you 'Windswept Pass' which will allow you to start on Windswept Island as usual.
To enable spawn locations within the game, make sure your world is set on Multiplayer, click Emergency Respawn and then you'll be able to pick where to spawn!
If doing Main Missions, make sure you've received the Survival Guide before you respawn.
If 'Player_Access' is capped at Zoe, then Isle of Murmurs and Isle of Silence will not be in the pool of possible starting locations.
The Main Quest: Complete all of the Main Missions.
The final main mission for this goal is the Tower Boss selected in 'player_access'.
Requires 'Main Missions' to be enabled or it won't generate.
Tower Rush: Defeat all the Tower Bosses.
You only have to defeat all tower bosses up to your max progression for this Victory Condition.
Legendary Hunter: Defeat or capture all of the Legendary Pals
Those being: Necromus, Paladius, Frostallion, Frostallion Noct, Jetragon, Neptilius and Panthalus.
This goal will be unavailable if 'player_access' doesn't reach Level 60 due to that being the lowest level of them.
Ancient Discovery: Discover all of the Ancient Ruins to Goal.
Requires 'Ancient Ruins' to be enabled or this goal will not generate.
Pal Raider: Defeat all of the Pal Raid Bosses.
Those being: Blazamut Ryu, Bellanoir, Bellanoir Libero, Xenolord and Hartalis.
This goal will be unavailable if 'player_access' doesn't reach Level 35 As that's the Level of Bellanoir which is the earliest Raid Boss you can fight.
Alpha Hunter: Defeat all of the Overworld Alpha Pals!
The Alpha Pals required for this goal are those that are visible as question marks on the map, this also includes the World Tree Alphas if the 'player_access' allows for it.
Does nothing if 'Enable_Alpha_Pals' is disabled.
Bounty Hunter: Defeat all of the Bounties!
The Bounties required for this goal are the various npcs that are visible as question marks on the map and is glowing purple.
Does nothing if 'Enable_Bounties' is disabled.
Master Chef: Cook all the various dishes within Palworld to goal!
Requires 'Chefsanity' enabled or this goal won't appear.
The Side Hustler: Require you to complete all the sub missions in the game to goal.
Requires 'Sub_Missions' enabled or this goal won't appear.
Pal Researcher: Require you to complete all of the Pal Labor Research Laboratory Tasks to goal.
Requires 'Research Task checks' enabled or this goal won't appear.
Full Palpedia: Require you to obtain all of the Pals available in the Palpedia to goal.
Requires 'Enable_Palpedia' to be enabled or this goal won't appear.
Journalist: Requires you to read all the Journals spread out throughout Palpagos Isles to goal.
This goal will not generate if 'Journals' are not enabled.
Palpagos Traveler: Require you to travel to all the Travel Points within Palpagos Isles to goal.
Watchtowers will not be accounted for in this goal despite both being travel points.
Dungeon Dweller: Require you to enter and defeat a boss from all of the Dungeons to goal.
Requires Dungeons as checks or it won't generate.
Feeling Lucky: Require you to find and capture a Lucky Pal in each Major Region to goal!

The Major Regions are as following; Windswept Island, Sea Breeze Archipelago, Bamboo Groves, Crescent Moon Shore, Verdant Brook, Astral Mountains, Mount Obsidian, Desiccated Dunes, Sakurajima, Feybreak, Sunreach and the World Tree.
Requires 'Lucky Pals' locations to be enabled or the goal won't generate.
Base Builder: Require you to max out your base in order to goal!
If you selected a lower Player Access setting, this goal will complete after constructing the highest building available.
Requires 'Base Tasks' to be enabled or it won't generate.
The Watcher: Require you to reach every watchtower in order to goal!
Not to be confused with ordinary Travel Points.
Arena Champion: Require you to beat and conquer all of the Arena Challenges to goal!
Requires 'Arena_Challenges' or it won't appear.
Fisherman: Require you to fish in every restricted location!
Requires 'Fishing_Spots' and 'Enable_Fishing' or it won't appear!
Effigy Collector: Collect all of the Effigies scattered around the world to goal!
You need at least one effigy type to be enabled for this to be able to goal.
Mimog Effigies are not accounted for in this goal! As they would be the same as the 'Full_Palpedia' goal.
If this is enabled, you'll require to complete every selected Goal before you're able to win.
If this option is disabled, you just require any of the above enabled goals to be completed to win.

Wears a blue coat.

Wears a red coat.

This will add a 'Secret Membership Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Black Marketeers.
This will add a 'Membership Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Wandering Merchants. Both Green and Red.
This will add a 'Pal Membership Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Pal Merchants.
This will add a 'Strange Membership Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Medal Merchants.
This will add a 'Bounty Hunter Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Bounty Hunter Shops.
This will add an 'Arena Membership Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Arena Merchant.
This will add recipes for all dishes you can cook into the item pool which will then be required before you can cook that recipe.
They'll be considered as progression items due to Chefsanity might require them.
Cakes you unlock through the Tech Tree will not have recipe items for them as they already limit them the same way.
This will add orbs of each Element into the pool, restricting the capture of pals if you do not have enough of said element.
They'll be treated as progression items.
The orbs will match the rarity number each pal has, excluding those with a rarity of 20, they'll require 11 orbs instead.
Dual-element Pals require both of its elements to have enough orbs for them to be in logic.
Does nothing if 'Enable Palpedia' is disabled.
Includes all dishes you can cook as checks.
When this is enabled, Pals found as Dungeon Bosses will be considered for logic.
Does nothing if 'Enable Palpedia' is disabled.
If this is disabled, Mau Cryst will still require 'Astral Mountains Cavern' before it is accessible. Since it only spawns naturally as a Dungeon Boss since 1.0.
When this is enabled, Pals obtained from wild Pal Eggs will be considered for logic.
Does nothing if 'Enable Palpedia' is disabled.
When this is enabled, Pals obtained from Fishing will be considered for logic.
Does nothing if 'Enable_Palpedia' is disabled.
When this is enabled, Pals obtained from the Fishing Pond will be considered for logic.
Does nothing if 'Enable Palpedia' is disabled.
When this is enabled, Pals obtained from the Pal Merchant will be considered for logic.
Does nothing if 'Enable Palpedia' is disabled.
When this is enabled, Pals obtained from the Black Marketeer will be considered for logic.
Does nothing if 'Enable Palpedia' is disabled.
When this is enabled, each dungeon requires its own key to access it.
Only exception is that the Sealed Realm of Terraria has a dungeon key of its own.
These keys will be added as items if this option is enabled.
This will add one of each Bounty Token which you receive from the Alpha Pal bosses into the item pool.
These tokens will be required before the boss gets in logic.
This option is automatically disabled if 'Player_Access' only goes to Zoe.
Does nothing if 'Enable_Alpha_Pals' is disabled.
This will add Egg Vouchers for each Element into the pool, restricting the hatching of pals if you do not have the voucher of said element and size.
They'll be treated as progression items.
The vouchers are Progressive, 1 voucher allows Normal Eggs, 2 vouchers allows Large Eggs, and 3 vouchers allows Huge Eggs.
Includes all of the dungeons as checks.
Includes finding a Lucky Pal in each Major Region as checks.

The Major Regions are as following; Windswept Island, Sea Breeze Archipelago, Bamboo Groves, Crescent Moon Shore, Verdant Brook, Astral Mountains, Mount Obsidian, Desiccated Dunes, Sakurajima, Feybreak, Sunreach and the World Tree.
When this is enabled, Pals that only have one parent pair while breeding will be considered for logic.
Includes exploration of various locations as checks.
A location is considered explored once its name appears on screen. Such as 'Golden Hills' and 'Autumn Rocks'.
This will add an item for each Pal into the pool, restricting the capturing of said Pal until you receive it.
They'll be treated as progression items.
The items are called 'Lamball's Bond', 'Cattiva's Bond' and so forth.
NOTE: This will make it so you require Panthalus' Bond before you are allowed to fight the boss.
Due to the nature of this Manual, these are removed automatically in accordance to 'player_access'.
As such it does nothing if 'Enable_Palpedia' is disabled.
Adds the three Oil Rigs as locations.
This will add an item for each Oil Rig into the pool which will be required to access them.
These items are called 'Weak Oil Rig Radar', 'Medium Oil Rig Radar' and 'Strong Oil Rig Radar'.
When this is enabled, any Materials dropped by Pals will be considered for logic. Such as Ingots from Bushi, Cloth from Croajiro and meat from Pals amongst other things.
If 'Enable_Fishing' is also enabled, it will consider fishing for logic as well.
When this is disabled, just a palbox will be required for logic most of the time due to the new merchants which sell most items. They're quite random and as such are only considered as a last resort.
When this is enabled, Any Mount will be required to travel across long distances.
When this is disabled, Only Mounts which can travel by water or the sky will be required to travel long distances.

When this is enabled, you don't require access to Feybreak before you are allowed to go to Sunreach. You may fly directly to the top of the tower and use the portal there. You won't need the Feybreak Pass to do so.
When this is disabled, you'll need either a flying mount or access to Bjorn before Sunreach gets into logic. As well as the Feybreak Pass.
When this is enabled, Pals will only be accessible in their regions if you can craft the Pal Sphere that is around the same level as the pal you can capture.
As an example, Pal Spheres are required to capture pals level 2-13 since at level 14 you can get the Mega Sphere Technology. For level 14-19 Pals you'll require the Mega Sphere instead.
If you are able to craft a higher tier sphere, they're usable as well.
If this is disabled, pals are accessible as soon as you reach their regions.
Does nothing if 'Enabled Palpedia' is disabled.
Adds one of each Treasure Map rarity into the item pool.
When received in the Multiworld you may allow yourself to use any Treasure Map of that rarity you find within Palworld.
This option is automatically disabled if Zoe is the max progression.
Common and Uncommon will be considered fillers.
Rare, Epic and Legendary will be considered useful.
Adds one of each Awakening Crystal and Radiant Gem into the item pool.
If the 'Ancient Workbench' is inaccesible due to the 'Player_Access' option, 'Radiant Gems' will be disabled.
These items will be considered useful.
This will add the Arena Challenges as locations!
Will require at least Lily to be accessible for this option to be enabled since the lowest challenge is level 20.
When this is enabled, You'll be able to visit any of the Miscellanous Islands as soon as you have access to a water or flying mount.
Not gonna torment you by travelling all over the ocean on a landbound mount.
When this is enabled, Items received from putting Pals in the Ranch will be considered for logic.
Does nothing if 'Enable_Palpedia' is disabled.
If enabled will add an 'Ancient Cipher' item to the item pool which will be required to access the Ancient Ruins.
You still require to be the same level as the area the Ancient Ruins is located at though!
This will add a fishing location to every location requiring a pass to access!
'Enable_Fishing' has to be enabled for these locations to show up as they follow the same logic!
Adds one check for each level from 2 to 80 depending on the 'player_access' setting!
This doesn't prevent the level cap from functioning if disabled as these are just extra locations for the manual.
You are still required to be a certain level before things are in logic even if you don't have these locations to guide you!
When enabled, will consider a pals' boosted Work Suitabilities at 4 Star for Research Tasks and Ancient Production stations.
Does nothing if 'Enable_Palpedia' is disabled.
